label: Louisiana Water Distribution Class 1-4 (practice)
purpose: Practice questions for the Louisiana Water Distribution Class 1, 2, 3 and 4 operator examinations, scoped to the distribution-system objectives in the dossier. Original items in US units. Not an official LDH examination, blueprint or Need-to-Know. Each item is labelled to one class. Excludes the Certification Law and Rules Examination, eligibility, fees, registration, renewal, state rule and statute clauses, site-specific procedures, emergency response and chemical-handling instructions.
reviewIntro: 250 original practice questions: 175 conceptual and 75 calculations, in US customary units, labelled Class 1 (60), Class 2 (65), Class 3 (65) and Class 4 (60). Topic scope comes from the dossier's objective summary. The LDH Need-to-Know outline itself could not be retrieved on 2026-11-27 (HTTP 403 from the origin), so item-level scope has not been checked against it. This is a local content package, not proof of a production import.

LA-OBJ: Louisiana Water Distribution Class 1-4 objectives, as summarised in the Louisiana Water Distribution readiness dossier (2026-10-29), which cites LDH Operator Need-to-Know: Water Distribution. Live outline not retrieved on 2026-11-27.

LA-COM: La. R.S. 40:1281.2 Committee of certification, retrieved 2026-11-27
